# OPEC Monthly Oil Market Report, issue 2015-06, page 69. Only the product price
# table is reproduced, laid out as pdfplumber extracts it. OPEC is the
# copyright holder and the assessments are Argus's. The MOMR disclaimer
# permits the information it carries to be reproduced for educational and
# other non commercial purposes with OPEC acknowledged, which is what this
# parser fixture is. The rest of the page is not reproduced and no MOMR PDF
# is committed anywhere in this repository.
#
# ONE SUBSTITUTION, and no other change. Where the report writes the minus
# sign of its change column as an en dash, this file writes an ASCII hyphen,
# because SPEC.md section 0.1 forbids an en dash anywhere in the repository.
# The character stands for the same minus and no digit is touched. The real
# document's dash family is covered separately by the to_float unit test.
